question: Which of the following is the closest layer to the Earth's surface in which all weather occurs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Troposphere.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **troposphere is the lowest part of the Earth's atmosphere** in which all tropical changes take place. 
 
• It contains about **75%** of the total air in the atmosphere.
 
• Based on temperature
